evidenceSummary.excerpt: And home gods reft of home: Lash thou thy winds, their ships submerge, Or toss them weltering o'er the surge.'"

This request was immediately granted. The vessels, tossed hither and thither, lost sight of each other. Some were stranded, some sank, and still the tempest raged on with unabated fury, and death stared the unhappy Trojans in the face.
"'Back to your master instant flee, And tell him, not to him but me The imperial trident of the sea Fell by the lot's award.'"

The Trojans, grateful for his timely aid, and reassured by the calm which now reigned supreme, steered for the nearest port, where they anchored their seven vessels, all that now remained of their once large fleet.
